en.html:
Kageaki"Kageaki Minato, Kamakura Police Station. My actions were on personal grounds. If you will refrain from treating them as interference, that is sufficient. Gratitude is not required."
Kanae"Oh, please. Such modesty puts me in a very difficult position. You save my life, then thanking you is not allowed. Shameless ingratitude is compulsory for me, is it? Nanny?"
Sayo"Entirely so, madam. Mr. Minato, our debt to you is considerable. Nevertheless, kindly do not reduce my mistress to a person without gratitude or shame."
Kageaki"Certainly not my intention. However, I have been rude. My apologies."

en.html:
...Achha.
From her side, that was indeed the situation.

Whether she had needed saving was another question. A little doubt remained there. Recalling her conduct, she seemed to have been confident of escaping the dragoon by some means of her own.

But even so, a person with manners could hardly say, your assistance was useless, take it back. Thanks were due. That sentiment I could understand. I nodded to myself and bowed.

The two women looked at each other and chuckled. This behavior of mine also was funny, perhaps.

She had saved the villagers from those brutal soldiers.
From my standpoint, she truly had no reason whatsoever to thank me. But that was not something she could know.

en.html:
Police ka naam liya, and this trouble had come along with it. But later, questioning the villagers, whose name could I use? 'Unknown fellow from outside, kindly supply your information' was unlikely to produce cooperation.

The lieutenant would hear about it, naturally. Better identify myself now. Otherwise suspicion would arrive later and bring all its relatives.

Then, with equal honesty, refuse to explain anything further.

An honest refusal. Very respectable phrase for a troublesome answer. If it displeased her, kya karein. No alternative.

en.html:
Kanae Ootori lowered her head and fell quiet. Her old attendant seemed to be digesting the explanation also.

The headman looked full to bursting with questions. But perhaps he had understood that Silver Star was not about to fall on us this very instant. He restrained himself. A welcome service. If he asked, explaining any further would be difficult.

I had brought him uncertainty and then silently hoped he would look after it himself. Not ideal police work. Still, for the moment, his silence was the most useful assistance anyone could offer.

Kanae"Leaving that aside. Remove the leader before complications arise, and everything is settled neatly, Mr. Minato."
Kanae"You want the magistrate caught. I want the magistrate caught. Same objective. Cooperation would follow naturally, no?"
Kageaki"One difficulty. Another magistrate could arrive and repeat the performance."
Kanae"Captain Nagasaka appears to have paid Civil Affairs from his own pocket to overlook the mining. If this were a shogunate project, why would his private pocket be required? No, this is his own venture."
Sayo"The profits will buy steps up the promotion ladder, I imagine. Until the enterprise is established, shogunate involvement is probably the last thing he wants. They would only help themselves to their share."
Kageaki"Understood. For the village also, no magistrate and no mining would be the best result. Is that a correct understanding?"
Village Chief"Ji, yes! More than we could ask for. Please, please help us. Only..."
Kageaki"Yes?"
Village Chief"His men. Not all have been caught... The rest may have joined him by now."
Sayo"Oh dear. Some have escaped our attention?"
Village Chief"The regular soldiers, I think those were all of them. But the suspicious fellows I mentioned... his bodyguards."
Kanae"Ah. How careless of me. I had quite forgotten."
Village Chief"They seem to have gone somewhere this morning. Such luck these people have... Apparently that is how they avoided Madam Inspector."
Kageaki"Understood. I shall keep it in mind."

香奈枝「まあ、それはさておいて。 　事が厄介になる前に首領格を潰してしまえ れば、万事は丸く解決なのです、湊斗さま」
香奈枝「わたくしもあなたもお代官を捕えたい。 　目的は一致、協力は当然と思われません？」
景明「問題が一点。 　別の代官が赴任してきて、また同じことに なるとも考えられます」
香奈枝「長坂大尉は採鉱事業を黙認させるために、 民政局へポケットマネーをばら撒いたご様子。 　幕命による事業なら彼個人がそんな真似を する必要はありません。つまり、これは独走」
さよ「この事業の収益を武器に出世階段を登って ゆく腹なのでしょうねぇ。むしろ事業が軌道 に乗るまでは幕府の介入を避けたいはず。 　上前をはねられるだけでございますから」
景明「納得です。 　村としても代官がいなくなり、採鉱事業が 中止となれば最善。そう考えて支障はありま せんか？」
村長「はい、はい！　願ってもないことでござい ます。どうかどうか、宜しくお頼み致します。 　ただ……」
景明「はい」
村長「代官の部下のことですが。 　今のところ、すべてが捕まっているという わけではなく……もしかすると、残りが代官 と合流しているかもしれません」
さよ「ま。これはしたり。 　見逃しがございましたか」
村長「正規の兵士はあれで全員だと思います。 　しかし先程も申しました、怪しげな連中が ……代官の用心棒の」
香奈枝「あら。 　いけない、うっかり忘れていました」
村長「奴らは今日は朝からどこかへ出掛けたよう でして。悪運が強いと申しますか……それで 巡察官さまとは出くわさずに済んだようで」
景明「諒解しました。 　念頭に置いておきます」
